messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved-pool-eu-west at 100% GPU reservation (reserved tenants impacted). Queue length for dedicated-resv is spiking x6 in last 5m. Autoscaler returned errors: rate_limit_exceeded. Paging @oncall.
Raj Patel: seeing the same in metrics. OrchidBank (enterprise tenant) has multiple long-lived sessions consuming 62% of reserved GPUs. Queue growth is mostly their sessions + a noisy non-reserved tenant leaking into the pool.
Keiko Tanaka: confirmed logs show repeated preempt attempts and failed burst allocations. Autoscaler logs:
```
ERROR autoscaler: scale_up request rejected: API rate limit exceeded (429)
WARN scheduler: failed to assign pod to resv-node-group: insufficient_gpus
```
Jun Park: @Raj can you dump the top-k sessions by GPU allocation? I want to see if it's single process or many small jobs.
Raj Patel: running quick query, will paste.
ops-admin-bot: `SELECT session_id, tenant, gpu_count, start_ts FROM resv_sessions WHERE pool='eu-west' ORDER BY gpu_count DESC LIMIT 10;` -> returns 3 sessions from OrchidBank (8, 6, 5 GPUs), 2 sessions from 'greenfield-pay' (4, 3), many small (1 GPU) from public-ml.
Dana (SRE Lead): key question: do we evict noisy tenant non-reserved sessions or raise capacity? Which has lower customer impact?
Mira - Customer Ops: OrchidBank is paying for reserved capacity; they're showing degraded latency. They've opened a support ticket. Account team pinged.
Evan Morris: I'm on the customer bridge with OrchidBank. They're seeing timeouts on long-generations and transcripts failing. They consider this P1.
Keiko Tanaka: Proposal: 1) throttle non-reserved tenants hitting resv pool by enforcing reservation isolation; 2) temporarily raise autoscaler quota for this account (manual bump) and do a controlled scale-up; 3) evict long-idle public sessions.
Jun Park: autoscaler quota bump requires org-admin + infra approval. I can open a temporary override but need sign-off. Also, scalers are unhappy because of a bug that retries too fast and hits external rate limits.
Raj Patel: quick mitigation I can run: identify public-ml sessions with recent GPU allocation < 60s and kill/evict them. That should free ~6 GPUs immediately.
Dana (SRE Lead): do it. Also Keiko, get me the exact API rate-limit error trace; we need to know which service is throttling.
Keiko Tanaka: posting traces now.
```
2026-03-15T01:12:34Z level=error component=autoscaler err="429 Too Many Requests from cloud-api (project-quota)"
caused_by: rapid parallel scale_up requests from scheduler and from legacy-batcher
```
Mira - Customer Ops: note to account team: we'll communicate that we're performing targeted evictions and capacity bump to restore OrchidBank latency. Asking if they'd accept a brief restart of some sessions (they prefer avoid restarts but ok for short ones).
Evan Morris: OrchidBank agreed to a 2-3 minute interruption if it gets them stable and we offer a follow-up incident report + credits.
Raj Patel: executing eviction script now: `./scripts/evict_public_resv_sessions.sh --pool eu-west --min-gpu 1 --dry-run false` -> freed 7 GPUs in 90s. Queue dropped ~45%.
ops-admin-bot: action taken by Raj Patel: evicted 12 sessions (ids: s-7234, s-7235, s-7299...). Resources freed: 7 GPUs.
Keiko Tanaka: requesting autoscaler override: `PATCH /infra/quota/overrides` payload with bump +3 GPUs to resv-node-group-eu-west. Need infra-admin token.
Dana (SRE Lead): I approve manual bump. Jun, can you coordinate with infra-admin to apply override? We'll monitor for 10m and revert.
Jun Park: pinging infra-admin via DM and raising a hot-config change. ETA 3m.
ops-admin-bot: infra-admin applied quota override for resv-node-group-eu-west: +3 gpus at 3178890060.
Jun Park: autoscaler started new nodes; however saw `failed_preempt` on two pods during startup; those recovered.
Raj Patel: queue length down to baseline for reserved tenants, OrchidBank latency improving to target 95th.
Evan Morris: relaying to OrchidBank: they're seeing improvements, will keep monitoring. Thanks.
Keiko Tanaka: follow-up: we need a permanent fix — autoscaler backoff/retry policy is causing external rate-limit storms when many scale events happen. Also need stronger reservation isolation so public workloads can't leak.
Dana (SRE Lead): agreed. Actions: 1) postmortem (owner: Keiko) due in 72h; 2) infra change: implement tokenized rate-limiter for autoscaler (owner: Jun) 2-week RFC; 3) product/ops: tighten reservation enforcement (owner: Raj) 1 sprint.
Mira - Customer Ops: publishing interim status to OrchidBank and offering 10% credit for interruption. Account manager will follow.
Evan Morris: closing customer bridge in 10m if metrics hold. I'll leave the channel once we confirm.
Incident Bot: Incident labeled: resv-pool-eu-west-capacity-exhaustion. Severity: P1 -> P2 after mitigation. Postmortem owner assigned: Keiko.
Dana (SRE Lead): thanks all. After-action note: we should automate a non-reserved eviction run when queue growth > threshold to avoid manual kills. File follow-up ticket.
Jun Park: created ticket INFRA-8421: autoscaler rate-limit backoff + coordinated scale. Linking postmortem.
Raj Patel: saving logs + session dumps in /var/incidents/3178889999 for the postmortem.
Mira - Customer Ops: I'll send the incident summary + customer commitments to account team.
Evan Morris: metrics look stable for 15m. I think we can call it resolved but keep watch for 1 hour.
Dana (SRE Lead): acknowledged. Marking this thread for incident follow-up. :white_check_mark:
